app.name: GYM
app.loadError: The app could not be loaded. Please sign in again.
app.confirmDelete: Really delete? This cannot be undone.

home.title: What is on today?
home.startBlockHint: Begin a recording or an evaluation in a cell. The cell's day protocol is created with it.
home.continueSkillHint: Record or evaluate a skill of the last days again.
home.analysisHint: History, volumes, quality and duration across all cells and skills.
home.noToday: Nothing is running today yet. Start a block.
home.noBlocks: No block on this day yet.
home.openBlocksHint: Carry on where you left off.

start.title: Start a block
start.noCells: No cells yet. Cells are maintained in the settings:
start.kindHint: Can still be changed in step 1 while the block is empty.
start.skillHint: What is this for? A skill collects recordings over all days and cells and is evaluated.
start.policyHint: Which trained version is evaluated? Optional.
start.name: Skill name
start.taskPlaceholder: e.g. move the cup from the table onto the tray, both hands
start.specHint: What the critics should check. Pick a spec of the critics service or upload one as a YAML or JSON file.

missing.name: The new skill needs a name.

continue.title: Continue a skill
continue.hint: Newest first. A new block takes over scene, target and plan of the last block of the same kind.

brief.title: Describe the scene
brief.lead: Set the target, then the scene: a photo and a few sentences. Quickest with the phone.
brief.scanHint: Scan the QR code: take a photo, speak or type, done. Shows up here at once.
brief.noPhoto: Upload a photo, or take one with the phone. Works without one, too.
brief.text: What am I going to do today?
brief.textPlaceholder: Scene and procedure in your own words
brief.targetHint: How many episodes should be recorded today?
brief.importHint: Newest first. Copies scene text, target and plan of the last block of the same kind, plus the task when this skill has none.
brief.importEmpty: No other skill with a fitting block.
brief.aiOff: No AI provider configured: the plan is proposed without AI.
brief.leadEvaluation: Set the number of rollouts, then the scene: a photo and a few sentences. Quickest with the phone.
brief.kindHint: A recording trains the skill, an evaluation tests a policy.
brief.kindLocked: With a plan or a dataset the kind is fixed.
brief.targetRolloutsHint: How often should the policy run today?
brief.textHint: Without a plan this is the task of the block.
brief.changeHint: Chosen when the block was started.
brief.noPlanHint: Without a plan: {n} episodes on the same task, no variations.
brief.noPlanNeedsTask: Without a plan the task has to be described.
brief.hasPlan: This block already has a plan. Proposing again replaces it.
brief.sceneHint: Photo and description, here or with the phone.

plan.title: Plan for the next hours
plan.lead: Proposal from photo and text: setups and variations. Everything can be changed and saves itself.
plan.instructionsPlaceholder: What to build, what to watch

image.title: Reference images per variation
image.lead: Optional: one picture per variation of how the scene should look.
image.promptPlaceholder: Move the cup 15 cm to the left and rotate it so the handle faces the robot.
image.promptHint: What changes against the scene photo. Camera, robot and table stay the same.
image.none: No picture yet. Images are optional.
image.off: No image model configured (GEMINI_API_KEY). Images can still be uploaded.
image.noScene: Without a scene photo no image can be generated. Uploading still works.

plan.leadEvaluation: Where the policy should run: the recorded variations first, then new ones. Everything can be changed.
plan.leadPlain: This block runs without a plan: the target number on the same task. One can still be built here.
plan.regenerateText: The new proposal replaces the current plan and every change made to it.
plan.incomplete: every step and every variation needs a name

recording.title: Recording
recording.lead: Start teleop. After every episode press Next, here or on the device at the cell.
recording.phone: On the device at the cell
recording.scanHint: Counts along on a phone or tablet, next and undo.
recording.downtimeHint: A standstill of the cell that the tool cannot see: write down the reason and how long it took.
recording.targetImage: What it should look like now
recording.selectStep: Click a step to continue there
recording.leadEvaluation: Start the policy, do not intervene. Press Next after every rollout.
recording.finishEvaluation: Finish the evaluation, go to upload
recording.setCountHint: Type a number and press Enter: sets the count directly instead of +1 each time

upload.title: Upload dataset
upload.lead: The recording as a zip in LeRobot format (data, videos, meta). Several zips at once are fine; each is checked by the critics on its own.
upload.dropHint: or click to choose files · several at once
upload.name: Dataset name
upload.already: Another upload is added to this block.
upload.onlyZip: Only zip files are accepted; other files were skipped.
upload.specHint: Applies to the skill, so to every upload from now on. Datasets that were already checked stay as they are.
upload.leadEvaluation: The rollouts as a zip in LeRobot format. The critics check each one; accept means success.
upload.removeDatasetText: "{name}" is deleted with its episodes, the stored zip and the critics run. It drops out of the analysis, the selection and the figures of the block. An earlier export no longer contains it when downloaded again.

review.title: Analysis
review.lead: The critics checked every episode. Rejected ones are already deselected for the selection.
review.hideFine: Hide the indicators that are fine
review.running: The critics are checking the dataset …
review.failed: The critics could not check the dataset.
review.vlmFailedTitle: The vision-language model did not answer
review.vlmFailedLead: Whether the task was done is therefore not checked. The verdicts rest on the technical checks alone.
review.vlmFailedHint: Usually the API key is missing in the critics service (see settings). Then upload the dataset again.
review.leadEvaluation: The critics checked every rollout. Accept means: the policy did the task.
review.followUpLead: The AI reads the findings and proposes which episodes to record again.
review.verdictRunning: The critics are still checking {n} dataset(s). The result shows up here by itself.
review.verdictMissing: {ok} of {target} episodes are good. {missing} still to go.
review.verdictPending: {n} rollouts are on “review” and need your decision below.
review.verdictManyRejected: Many episodes were rejected. The hints at the dataset say why.
review.detailsHide: Hide the details of the critics

selection.title: Select episodes and download
selection.lead: Every recording of this skill, over all days and cells. Rejected ones are deselected. Where you disagree with the critics, set your verdict with ✓ or ✗; it counts in every figure at once.
selection.datasetHint: Merged dataset: the selected episodes as one LeRobot dataset, ready to train. Manifest: only the lists, for your own pipelines.
selection.datasetBuildingHint: The critics are putting the episodes together and copying the videos. Depending on the amount this takes a few minutes; please leave the window open.
selection.exportHead: Does the episode go into the export?
selection.verdictHint: The critics' verdict, or yours over it. It counts in every figure.

closed.title: Block closed
closed.lead: Done. The day protocol lists every block of the day; the print view can be shared by link.
closed.reviewLead: The review by hand works after the block is closed as well: success or not, failure mode, variation, note. Every change is saved at once and counts for the skill and the reports.
closed.confirmText: The block's time ends and the phone link stops working. You can reopen it any time.

skill.name: Name
skill.noBlocks: No block for this skill yet.
skill.archiveConfirm: Archive the skill? It disappears from the start picker; everything stays.
skill.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill with all blocks, datasets, exports and policies? The day protocols stay.
skill.evaluationsLead: Every evaluation is a block: the policy runs, every rollout is recorded and judged by the critics, a person may review it. Succeeded means the task was done. Oldest first, so the course reads. Several blocks together make a report.
skill.policiesLead: A policy is a trained version of the skill. It is created here so evaluations can say what they tested.
skill.deletePolicyHint: Evaluations of this policy stay and only lose the reference.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.vlmFailedTitle: The VLM did not answer on {n} runs
analysis.vlmFailedLead: These runs were judged by the hard critics alone. Task success, anomalies and people in the workspace are not checked in them, so the figures below are missing that part.

settings.title: Settings
settings.cellsHint: The cells of the gym. A cell with day protocols can be deactivated, not deleted.
settings.deleteCellHint: Only possible while no day protocol was kept in it.
settings.collectionsHint: Customer projects or use cases. A collection groups skills.
settings.deleteCollectionHint: The skills stay and only lose their grouping.
settings.rolesHint: Every member is an operator and sees the analysis. Owners and admins maintain cells and people.
settings.aiHint: Gemini via GEMINI_API_KEY, else the server's central provider (AI_PROVIDER). Without AI the app proposes a standard plan.
settings.criticsHint: The lerobot-critics service checks every uploaded dataset (hard critics from parquet and video, soft critics via a VLM) and returns verdicts, flags and the recording-session profile. Configured with CRITICS_URL and CRITICS_API_KEY.
settings.criticsNoVlm: no VLM key, hard critics only
settings.specsHint: A spec tells the critics what they measure an episode against: the task, the success indicators and the technical checks. Without a spec the critics derive everything from the dataset. It is picked per skill.
settings.aiImagesOn: Reference images of the variations are on ({model}).
settings.aiImagesOff: No reference images: they need GEMINI_API_KEY. Images can still be uploaded by hand.
settings.noSpecs: No spec in the critics service yet.

mobile.invalid: This link is no longer valid. Scan the QR code on the cell's screen again.

capture.lead: First a photo of the scene, then say or write briefly what happens today.
capture.step2: What am I going to do today?
capture.speechUnsupported: This browser has no speech input, just type.
capture.doneHint: The cell's screen picks up photo and text.
capture.thanksHint: Photo and text arrived on the cell's screen. This window can be closed.

run.title: Recording
run.noPlan: This block has no plan yet.

print.title: Day protocol
print.notFound: This day protocol does not exist.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHint: The address is your login. A change is sent to the new address and confirmed there.
profile.passkeysHint: Sign in with fingerprint, face or security key instead of an e-mail link.
profile.passkeysOff: Passkeys are not configured on this server.
profile.passkeysUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
profile.tokensHint: For scripts and imports from cell computers. The token is shown exactly once.
profile.tokenCreated: Token created. Copy it now, it will not be shown again.
profile.revokeText: Scripts using this token lose access immediately.
profile.joined: You are now a member of {name}.
profile.passkeyHint: Passkeys need a BASE_URL with the public domain on the server (e.g. https://gym.example.com).
profile.tokenScopesHint: Multiple choice: hold Ctrl or Cmd to pick more than one permission.

spec.uploadHint: A spec as a YAML or JSON file. It is stored in the critics service; a spec of the same name is replaced.
spec.autoHint: The critics derive the check from the dataset itself: task text, robot and thresholds come from the data.
spec.chosen: Spec “{name}” is no longer in the critics service. The next upload runs automatically.
spec.what: A spec tells the critics what they measure an episode against:
spec.whatTask: The task in plain words and the objects of the scene. The question to the vision-language model is built from it.
spec.whatSoft: The success indicators: what has to hold at the end, each with a weight. An indicator with a gate rejects the episode when it does not hold.
spec.whatHard: The technical checks on signals and videos (tremor, image quality, duration, grasp cycles) with weights and thresholds.
spec.whatAuto: Without a spec the critics derive everything from the dataset. A spec of your own makes the judgement comparable over days and cells.
spec.empty: No spec in the critics service yet.
spec.pickOne: Pick a spec on the left, or start one from a preset with "New".
spec.name: Name
spec.nameHint: Letters, digits, "_", "." and "-". A spec of the same name is replaced.
spec.yamlHint: The text behind the form. Changes here are taken over when you switch back to the form.
spec.deleteHint: The spec is removed from the critics service. Datasets that were already checked stay as they are.
spec.deleteUsed: These skills work with it: {skills}. Their next uploads are checked automatically until another spec is picked.
spec.discardText: The spec was edited and not saved yet.
spec.presetHint: Every preset is a complete spec for a typical scene: objects, success indicators, gates and checks are set. Then adjust the words and save.

pick_place.title: Pick and place
pick_place.desc: Bring one object to a target: cup on tray, part into box.

repeated.title: Repeated cycles
repeated.desc: Several identical grasp cycles per episode, e.g. moving three cubes. Duration and cycle count are checked per cycle.

sorting.title: Sorting
sorting.desc: Several kinds of objects into different zones, with distractors that must not be moved.

insertion.title: Insertion
insertion.desc: Peg into hole, plug into socket: alignment, no jamming, steady motion weigh more.

bimanual.title: Bimanual with handover
bimanual.desc: One arm grasps, the other places. Both arms active, a clean handover as an indicator.

evaluation.title: Policy evaluation
evaluation.desc: Only the outcome counts: task done or not. Motion quality without weight, the vision-language model weighted twice.

blank.title: Start empty
blank.desc: Only the critics' defaults. Enter the task, the rest as needed.

spec.secTaskHint: What the robot does and with what. The question to the vision-language model is built from it.
spec.instructionHint: In English, the way the model should judge the episode.
spec.instructionPlaceholder: put the red cup on the tray
spec.sceneHint: What stands in the cell and where. Free text, for the model.
spec.scenePlaceholder: A table with a red cup and an empty tray in front of the robot.
spec.objectsHint: The target object and target zone shape the wording of the default indicators.
spec.expectedCyclesHint: Empty = one or unknown. Set, the critics check the count.
spec.perEpisodeHint: Whether the model judges against the episode's text stored in the dataset instead of this sentence.

perEpisode.auto: auto: only when the dataset carries several tasks
perEpisode.always: always, when the episode carries a text

spec.notesHint: What is normal and does not count as a failure, e.g. the recording protocol or pauses.
spec.secSoftHint: The vision-language model scores each from 0 to 1, weighted.
spec.softOff: Without the vision-language model only the technical checks count. Nobody then sees whether the task succeeded.
spec.noIndicators: No indicator yet. Without indicators of your own the critics use their five default indicators.
spec.indicatorPlaceholder: The red cup stands on the tray at the end of the episode.
spec.gateHint: A gate rejects the episode when the value is below the threshold, however good the rest is.
spec.gateFlagsHint: These findings reject the episode outright.
spec.insertDefaultsHint: The critics' five indicators, worded for the target object and zone above.
spec.secHardHint: On signals and videos. What is ticked runs; unticked does not.
spec.noParams: The critics service is not reachable, the parameters of this check are unknown.
spec.paramsHint: Empty means default. Lists and mappings as JSON, e.g. ["left"] or {"joint_3": [0, 90]}.

integrity.label: Integrity
integrity.desc: Do parquet, meta and videos agree: length, timestamps, NaN, frame count.

duration.label: Duration
duration.desc: Episode length in seconds within min_s and max_s.

smoothness.label: Smoothness
smoothness.desc: Jerk, tremor in the speed profile, spikes, hesitation mid-motion.

tracking_error.label: Tracking error
tracking_error.desc: Gap between command (leader) and robot (follower), latency, stalls.

duplication.label: Duplicate frames
duplication.desc: Frozen camera images while the robot moves, frozen commands.

image_quality.label: Image quality
image_quality.desc: Brightness, over- and underexposure, sharpness per camera.

sensor_limits.label: Sensor limits
sensor_limits.desc: Limits and dead zones per axis, stuck or saturated values.

grasp_cycles.label: Grasp cycles
grasp_cycles.desc: Counts gripper close and open, checks against the expected count, finds unfinished grasps.

tremor.label: Tremor
tremor.desc: Shaking of the input device and jitter in hold phases.

normalization.label: Normalization
normalization.desc: Zero frames, constant axes, drifting idle arms, copied actions: everything that corrupts training statistics.

diversity.label: Spatial diversity
diversity.desc: Spread of the grasp positions over the run. Informational only, weight 0.

duration.margin_frac: How far outside the bounds the score reaches 0, as a fraction of the bound.
duration.per_cycle: Bounds per grasp cycle instead of per episode, when grasp cycles per episode is set.

grasp_cycles.expected_cycles: Overrides the grasp cycles per episode from the task.
grasp_cycles.tolerance: Allowed deviation from the expected count without penalty.
grasp_cycles.min_hold_s: A shorter closure does not count as a grasp.

image_quality.brightness_lo: Lower bound of the mean brightness (0 to 255).
image_quality.brightness_hi: Upper bound of the mean brightness (0 to 255).
image_quality.cameras: Check only these cameras, as a JSON list.

spec.secScoringHint: How the values become the verdict: accept, review, reject.
spec.acceptThresholdHint: Total score from here and no gate fired: accepted.
spec.reviewThresholdHint: Between here and "Accept from": review. Below: rejected.
spec.hardWeightHint: Share of the technical checks in the total score.
spec.softWeightHint: Share of the success indicators in the total score.
spec.ignoreFlagsHint: These findings do not count for this setup, neither as a gate nor for "review". Comma-separated.
spec.secRobotHint: Optional. Empty, the critics take everything from the dataset.
spec.activeArmsHint: Empty = all. An arm that should rest is checked for drift instead of tracking error.
spec.primaryCameraHint: Shown large to the model. Empty = the first non-wrist camera.
spec.errorTitle: The spec cannot be saved like this:

error.indicatorId: Two indicators carry the same id.

spec.wizardHint: Create a spec step by step from a sample dataset

kindHint.recording: Teleoperation, the data trains the skill
kindHint.evaluation: A policy runs, its rollouts are judged

dayView.closeConfirm: Close the day? Open blocks are closed with it.
dayView.deleteBlockConfirm: Delete the block for "{skill}" with its {n} datasets and all episodes? The day protocol stays.
dayView.deleteText: The day with its {n} blocks, all datasets and episodes is deleted. This cannot be undone.

failure.F-07: Unexpected motion after the task was complete
failure.F-08: Hardware / infrastructure (not charged to the policy)

rollouts.title: Review the rollouts
rollouts.lead: The critics judged first. Here a person has the last word: success or not, why it failed, and which variation the rollout ran in. What you set here counts for the success rate of the block, the skill and the reports.
rollouts.empty: No rollouts yet. They appear once the critics have judged a dataset.
rollouts.pendingHint: The critics say “review”. Until a person decides, they do not count as a success.
rollouts.invalid: {n} invalid (F-08), not charged to the policy
rollouts.vlmLead: The VLM column shows how the vision-language model saw the rollout. Expanding the row shows its reasoning per indicator and the anomalies with time stamps.
rollouts.pickByFlagHint: tick or untick all {n} rollouts with {flag}
rollouts.applySuggestionsHint: Sets the failure mode the critics' findings point at on every rollout that has none yet

report.title: Evaluation report
report.lead: A report reads one or more evaluation blocks together: a policy on one day, or the checkpoints of a training run against each other. The figures come live from the rollouts, the critics and the human review; the team writes the text.
report.none: No report for this skill yet.
report.create: Create a report from the selection
report.createHint: Tick blocks in the table, then create the report. The order of the blocks is the order in the report.
report.pickBlocks: Tick the blocks for the report
report.name: Name
report.namePlaceholder: e.g. CW 38 · Humanoid v1 · two cup pick place
report.shareHint: The view under this link is readable by anyone, without signing in.
report.deleteConfirm: Delete the report “{name}”? The blocks and rollouts stay.
report.blocksHint: Order and choice of the skill's evaluation blocks.
report.pendingLead: {n} rollouts have no decision yet: the critics say “review” and no person has judged them. They do not count as a success. Review them in their block so the report is complete.
report.vlmLead: On {n} datasets the vision-language model did not answer. The critics' verdicts there say nothing about the task's success; only the human review counts for them.
report.byBlockHint: A block is one evaluation: one policy, one day, one cell. The bar shows the rate, the bracket the Wilson 95 % interval.
report.byVariationHint: The variations of the evaluation plan over all blocks. A rollout belongs to the variation the review names, else to the one the plan has at its position.
report.noVariations: The plan names no variations and the review set none.
report.failureModesHint: failed rollouts with a failure mode, counted per block
report.noFailureModes: No failure mode assigned yet. Failure modes are set when the rollouts are reviewed.
report.everyRolloutHint: all rollouts of the blocks with the critics' verdict, the human decision and the failure mode
report.noRollouts: The blocks of this report have no judged rollouts yet.
report.lineageHint: blocks, datasets and policies the report is computed from

findings.title: Weigh the findings
findings.lead: Every finding of the critics has an effect: it rejects an episode, caps it at review, or is a hint. When a finding does not fit your setup, downgrade it here. The critics then replay the verdicts; your review by hand stays.
findings.criticsLead: A critic that does not fit your setup is switched off here: it no longer counts, neither with its score nor with its gate or its findings. The critics replay the verdicts; your review by hand stays.

wizard.viewingHint: The block stays at “{step}”; nothing changes here.
wizard.clockHint: Teleop time only runs once you continue the recording.
wizard.noPlanYet: No plan yet. It is made once the run starts.

errors.noPlan: This block has no plan yet. Create one or start without a plan.
errors.blockClosed: The block is closed. Reopen it to change it.
errors.needsTask: Without a plan the block needs a description of the task.
errors.waitForCritics: Upload a dataset first and wait until the critics are done.
errors.kindLocked: With a plan or a dataset the kind of the block can no longer change.
errors.noScenePhoto: This needs a scene photo on the block.
errors.noImageModel: No image model is set up. Pictures can be uploaded.
errors.imageTooLarge: The picture is larger than 15 MB.
errors.imageType: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
errors.zipOnly: Please upload the dataset as one zip in LeRobot format (data, videos, meta).
errors.importNothing: That skill has no matching block to take over.
errors.evaluationNoSelection: An evaluation has no episode selection.
errors.cellInUse: The cell has day protocols. Deactivate it instead of deleting it.
errors.uploadBroken: The upload arrived incomplete. Please upload it again.
errors.datasetTooLarge: The dataset is too large. Please split it into several zips.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
errors.notFound: Not found. It may have been deleted in the meantime; please reload the page.

specWizard.title: Spec wizard
specWizard.lead: A spec is worked out from real data here: upload a sample dataset, the critics look at X episodes in auto mode, and you go through their proposal step by step. Every input is saved at once.
specWizard.newHint: From a sample dataset that is kept only while the wizard runs.
specWizard.discardText: The sample dataset and the analyses are deleted, no spec is stored.
specWizard.zipOnly: Please pick the LeRobot dataset as one zip file.
specWizard.sheetOpen: Show the contact sheet of episode {n} large
specWizard.sheetHint: Each row is a camera, time runs from left to right.
specWizard.lead_task: What should the robot do, with which objects? On the right is what the dataset recorded.
specWizard.lead_robot: Which arm works, and which camera does the language model look at first?
specWizard.lead_save: Check the spec on the same episodes and store it.

purposeHint.recording: Teleoperation, the episodes are judged as training data.
purposeHint.evaluation: A policy runs, judged is whether the task succeeded.

sample.title: Sample dataset
sample.lead: A typical dataset of this task, as it comes out of the recording. It is stored for the wizard only and deleted afterwards.
sample.skillHint: At the end the spec can be assigned to the skill directly.
sample.sizeHint: Spread evenly over the dataset, at most {max}. More episodes show more but take longer.
sample.drop: Drop the zip here or pick it
sample.dropHint: LeRobot dataset as one zip file: data, videos, meta. The analysis starts by itself afterwards.

analysis.title: Auto analysis
analysis.lead: The critics look at {n} episodes, generate a spec proposal from them and judge the sample with it.
analysis.wait: This can take a few minutes. You may leave the page, the draft waits here.
analysis.stale: {ran} episodes were analysed, {want} are set now.
analysis.verdictsHint: How the critics judge the sample with the automatically generated spec. This is the starting point you sharpen in the next steps.
analysis.sheetsHint: One contact sheet per episode: each row a camera, time from left to right. A click shows it large.

task.several: The dataset holds several tasks. Each episode is then measured against its own task.
task.cyclesHint: How often the gripper grasps per episode. With the right number an episode with several repetitions is not flagged as a multi grasp.

robot.typeHint: Read from the dataset. Change it only when it is wrong.
robot.armsHint: Only the active arms are checked for motion and tracking. Without a choice, all.
robot.autoCameraHint: The critics take the first camera that is not on a wrist.
robot.cameraHint: The language model shows this camera large. The row names the line in the contact sheet on the right.
robot.lookHint: row 1 on top, the other cameras below

success.vlmFailed: The language model did not judge the sample. The criteria are stored anyway and take effect once it is available.
success.vlmOff: No language model ran for the sample. The criteria take effect in the next analyses.
success.reworded: The model judged the old wording: “{old}”. The scores belong to it, the test run shows the new one.
success.notJudged: A new criterion: the model has not judged it yet, the test run shows it.

scoring.liveHint: Every change on the left and every button below acts on the episodes at once.

save.testHint: Your spec on the same episodes of the sample
save.testRunning: The critics check the sample with your spec.
save.testNone: No test run yet. It is optional but shows what your spec really decides.
save.storeHint: The spec is stored with the critics
save.name: Spec name
save.assign: Use it for “{skill}” from now on
save.storeNote: Afterwards the sample dataset and the analyses are deleted.
save.existsText: Overwriting replaces it for every skill that uses it.

flags.title: Flags
flags.hint: What the model and the checks found in the sample, and what each flag does
flags.criterion: The model scores the success criterion “{text}” below 0.5.
flags.noMeaning: The critics gave no description for this flag.

choiceHint.out: An episode with this flag is rejected.
choiceHint.review: An episode with this flag is held at review at most, a person looks at it.
choiceHint.info: The flag is shown with the episode but does not change the verdict.
choiceHint.ignore: The flag is switched off: not shown, not counted.

effect.stop: stops the episode through the check “{check}”

bench.agree: the spec decides {n} of {of} like you
bench.judgeHint: Say of episodes whether they are good or bad: then you see where the spec decides differently.
bench.differs: The spec decides differently from you
bench.noVideo: No video, the contact sheet instead
bench.paramsNote: Parameters change what the check measures. Only the test run shows that, the live view works with the measured values.
bench.criterionText: Success criterion (the words for the model)
bench.stopVsTag: The stop hangs on the model's score. The flag below is only a label, set for a score below 0.5.
bench.criterionGone: This criterion is no longer in the spec. It does not count any more.
bench.modelHint: Whether the model sees the task done as a whole, and what it noticed. Counts through its flags only.
bench.totalsHint: The dots are the total scores of the episodes. Left of the line: not accepted. A stop rejects wherever the dot lies.
bench.previewNote: Live from the results of the analysis. Reworded criteria and changed parameters show in the test run.
bench.flagStops: Besides, the flag {flag} stops {n} of {of} episodes wherever the line lies. Change that with the flag below.

specWizard.lead_workbench: The whole sample in one view: the episodes on the left, the video and every result of the open episode in the middle, the settings on the right. Every change acts on every verdict at once.
